question: In which year were the major economic reforms introduced in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1991**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Major economic reforms in India were introduced in **1991** under the leadership of then Prime Minister **P.V. Narasimha Rao** and Finance Minister **Dr. Manmohan Singh**.
 
• The 1991 reforms were initiated to address a severe **balance of payments crisis** and economic stagnation.
